original_test_intent: Verify the powered system's complete XGMI node fabric forms the expected closed ring and every required link reports XGMI3 at 32 Gbps x16.
original_method: Verify exact GPU-node/link topology and approved AMDXIO binary, execute only its read-only XGMI link-status operation with authorized privilege, preserve complete output and map every directed/physical link to ring closure, generation, speed and width criteria.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the compatible AMDXIO artifact and authoritative node/link/ring matrix, approves sudo execution and reviews any missing or degraded link.
required_inputs: Exact SUT and GPU node/port inventory with expected closed-ring adjacency
Expected per-link XGMI generation, 32 Gbps speed and x16 width representation
AMDXIO release/path/checksum, platform compatibility and documented output schema
Authorized least-privilege execution method and protected host access
Disposition of the erroneous AMDGPU-RAS/Redfish package and evidence fields
safety_requirements: Verify binary checksum/provenance and target identity before privileged execution
Keep execution read-only; prohibit injection, CPER retrieval, link retraining, driver reload, firmware or power changes
Preserve full output and existing logs; do not clear logs or truncate to tail output
Use protected credentials and verified host keys; stop on unsupported output or unexpected side effect
Do not merge evidence with the same-code row-2080 variant
agent_execution_scope: Verify topology matrix, target, AMDXIO identity and read-only command contract
Run the exact approved link-status command once and capture complete stdout/stderr/status
Parse and report each expected node/link, adjacency, generation, speed and width plus duplicates/unknowns
Evaluate ring closure only against the owner matrix and package evidence for engineer verdict
Perform no injection, mutation, log clear or independent DUT decision
engineer_actions: Resolve AMDXIO versus AMDGPU-RAS/Redfish package/evidence conflict and approve the correct artifact
Supply authoritative XGMI ring/port matrix and exact representation of XGMI3 32 Gbps x16
Review complete per-link evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture AMDXIO/tool/SUT identities and full machine-readable-or-raw link table, normalize endpoints, prove degree/connectivity/ring closure and compare each link's generation/rate/width with no mutation.

review_improvement: Removes unrelated destructive RAS content, preserves shared-code identity separation and turns the topology claim into complete per-edge evidence instead of a truncated console snapshot.
independent_technical_reasoning: Ring validity is a graph property, not a string match: all expected nodes must be connected with the approved adjacency and no missing, duplicate or unknown edge. Link generation, rate and width are per-edge properties, so a single summary line cannot establish the criteria for all links. Because the same code later labels a destructive GFX RAS test, the row/variant identity and artifact boundaries are critical to prevent a valid CPER result from being falsely credited as XGMI connectivity evidence.
